notes.title: Major Update To The Demo :)
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to bring you the latest update full of fixes and improvements, not to mention SINGLE PLAYER IS HERE !!!

Community Feedback Fixes:
- Various multiplayer network issues on both maps
- Higher FPS and general performance improvements
- Soft lock fixes
- Movement improvements to players
- Rock colliders fixed
- 2x New AI 'Monster' Shifts added
- Ability firing issues resolved
- Happiness carnival gamemode, ripped out and replaced with a new task-based system
- Single player added with AI enemies
- New lobby tools for single player, difficulty and private games
- Firefighter abilities are addressed with teleporting
- New Shift smoke fart ability added
- Problematic tasks and getting stuck have been addressed
- Door colliders have been changed to make gameplay smoother
- Intro scene Skip button now loads in the background while the map loads, giving a better experience after a short delay
- Rides improved on carnival (Horses, Cups & Saucers, Stalls)

Dev Fixes:
- Single player mode added on both maps
- A* algorithm AI monsters to hunt players and execute abilities on them
- New end screen for Lion Tamer
- Improved user flow on the carnival map
- Fixed movement and logic behaviour on the merry-go-round Minigame
- Fixed movement and logic behaviour on the Ferris wheel ride
- Fixed a general behaviour issue on the stall Minigames
- Fixed general multiplayer connection issues that impacted gameplay on all maps
- Improved general user flow with a new guidance system to help newer players who felt lost before
- Implemented new NPC enemies to improve single-player and co-op gameplay
- Improved controls and behaviour of the bumper cars on the carnival map
- Fixed an issue that caused the in-game volume controls for proximity chat not working properly
- Upgraded lobby and matchmaking system
- Lockpicker and Psychologist now speak when you use voice chat, other characters soon will
- Fear shows on Lockpicker and Psychologist's faces as it increases
- New van keys task added to Carnival, and ending reworked
- Lion whip attack now does damage correctly when on target
- Duck shooting task code reworked and improved

Areas currently under development:

- In-Game UI
- Void door bug on the map still appears occasionally (Mansion Map)

Challenge :
If you are a streamer and can beat the mansion, using the lockpicker, on insanity difficulty, any shift AI, you win a mini prize, max 3 gifts per streamer.

We hope you and your friends have a lot of fun exploring secrets together!

Much Love,
Futura Games[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: MASSIVE UPDATE + SINGLE PLAYER (SEE VIDEO)
notes.content:
[p]Hi all :)[/p][p][/p][p]After a couple of months listening to the community and reading your thoughts, we sat down and made a ton of improvements to the game and even a couple of new features.[/p][p][/p][p]Apart from fixing pretty much everything mentioned by the community (apart from the dreaded void door which we're still working on) we are happy to say that the new version coming out Friday 13th is a massive improvement to the title.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate bringing you more value we are also lowering the price of Shadows so you can play with more friends.[/p][p][/p][p]Biggest changes :
[/p][list][*][p]Single player mode is here ![/p][/*][*][p]AI Shift (Demonic currently active) with difficulty levels, no more waiting in lobbies, get stuck in[/p][/*][*][p]Carnival overhaul and game play changed to be task orientated[/p][/*][*][p]A new guidance system to assist navigating the map sand prevent people getting lost[/p][/*][*][p]FPS increases, networking improvements, stability improvements & other general performance upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby has been upgraded to have a single player mode and longer lifetime waiting for people to connect[/p][/*][*][p]The big fuse box in the mansion has been changed to be more reliable in game and easier to use[/p][/*][*][p]Latency improvements[/p][/*][*][p]New additional task on Carnival for the ice cream truck ending[/p][/*][*][p]tons more but I don't want to go too technical and bore you to death.  So here's a video from one of our content creators who has recently got his hands on the latest build before we release it, it's not the final build you will see on the 13th but its close.[/p][/*][/list][p]We look forward to you all seeing the improvements made after listening to you all to make this much better and stable.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2shKgWWGFfk;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531720/9e3c293e5189f763510b5aaf48444194ed1bb9f6.png[/img]

Various bug fixes to the Carnival map and user flow.

[list]
[*] Loading screens now wait for all connected
[*] Informational page added with instructions on how to play Tug of War game mode
[*] Informational (green) messages added for user experience at various points
[*] Bumper cars no longer max happiness meter due to double-firing issues
[*] Shift can now play bumper cars claw machine
[*] Shift can now play merry-go-round zombie cannon to knock kids off horses
[*] Stalls - minor adjustments
[*] New shift no longer freezes upon teleporting kids
[*] New shift attacks adjusted (no rush knocking of heroes)
[*] Task system added to heroes on Carnival to help users understand the Tug of War flow
[*] Font sizes increased on tasks for more accessibility
[*] Green messages added to stalls in various languages
[*] Cups and Saucers no longer accessible or locks you in, will be playable soon
[*] End scene messages added to win scenarios on Carnival
[/list]

Theres much more coming, in fact, we've got an alpha version of the AI Shift for single players and small hero groups who want to take on an AI Shift.  It's not in this build but is top priority to improve your gameplay experience and help solo players enjoy Shadows more.

Speak soon, 
Team Futura :)

notes.title: Patch Hotfix 0-0-1
notes.content:
General :
-Colliders on cages in mansion repaired as kids could escape too easily
-3d Audio sound of haunted house gun bullets realigned with distance (you could hear them everywhere)
-Happiness win bar not functioning correctly (Network latency from server to player issue, resolved)
-Attic door / colliders in mansion resolved
-Electric eel error breaking bumper cars resolved
-Horses shift hot zone breaking network messages fixed (shift triggered it when no players were on the ride)
-Instructions splash screen added to Carnival Map for more user flow assistance 'Hot To Play' (multilingual)
-Tutorial no longer sees the second Shift
-End scene hero scenario audio
-New jump scare added to library
-More fuel added to Carnival map
-Stopped shift getting player messages on Carnival for certain tasks
-New scares added to carnival tents (you'll have to find out which for yourselves)
-Ticket master spinning rates updated

Art :
-Fixed doorway collider issue
-Fixed potato and medium LODs and properly set up renders to automate shift with quality settings
-Lion shift collision restored
-Fixed lion tamer camera clipping through walls
-Fixed lion body camera clipping
-Improved cards particle material
-Updated haunted house prefab with material fixes and some lighting placements and tuning
-Fixed character clipping when holding a lantern and crouch walking
-Improved lighting in all win ending scenarios of mansion
-Corrected character crawl after shift victory so they don't clip through lanterns
-Hid lanterns in victory scenes to look better and resolve visual bugs
-Improved distortion material
-Fixed mirrors so they use a custom skybox, so we don’t need to hide the sky on the player cameras
-Smoothed models that needed it
-Added TAA to end scene and intro to game scene where she is at the desk (was missing)
-Added a few more environmental details and some clean up outside the courtyard and garage

notes.title: Slight Delay
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531720/494e523d11da9394c7b6ef28f34d43cf8f84eb35.jpg[/img]

Hi all, 
We just wanted to keep you all in the loop, the game was planned to be released today however there are a few small changes required before it can be approved for release on Steam. 

In order to have the build approved we need to complete the translation work on the Book of Shadows and adjust a few settings such as controller support in the store page as it isn't working on the in game menu correctly.

We're pushing a new upload to Steam this evening which will hopefully get approved quickly and then we can let you guys have some Carnival fun.  Realistically though, it may be delayed until this Halloween weekend before the Early Access release comes out, we are hopeful it get's approved sooner.

Apologies for the delay, 
Much love, Team Futura.
